summary: Stewards, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 4 to its Loan Agreement with Stewards International Funds PCC (Lender). The amendment extends the facility closing date from August 31, 2026 to November 15, 2026, maintains the 8.00% fixed interest rate, Maturity Date of August 31, 2030, and $100 million facility limit. It also reduces warrant coverage for principal funded after August 31, 2026 to one warrant per $3.00 funded, from one per $0.76 previously, with exercise price unchanged at $0.76. This is a routine financing agreement modification, not a special situation such as a tender offer, acquisition, or strategic review, so it is classified as 'None'.
